card.title: PANTHER D
card.text: When this unit attacks, the damage it deals is also dealt to the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The Panther tank, officially known as Panzerkampfwagen V Panther or PzKpfw V, was a German medium tank that was used from 1943 until the end of the war in 1945. The first production Panther tank was the Ausf.D, not the Ausf.A. This confuses many people since in the past German tank versions started with the letter A and then went on to B, C, D, etc. The Panther tank was developed for the purpose of countering the T-34 and to replace the Panzer III and Panzer IV tanks. It is by some considered the best tank of WWII, but it was rushed to the Battle of Kursk in 1943 even though it still had many known technical issues. As a result, many tanks broke down during the battle. They managed to fix most of these problems by the end of 1943 and early 1944, but new issues arose, such as the bombings of the tank factories, shortages of high-quality materials for important parts, a lack of fuel to train new crews, and the new tank crews not being as skilled as they should be. All of these things made the Panther tank less effective in combat. Around 6,000 Panther tanks were built, including quite a few variants, and approximately 842 of these were Panther Ds.
